- Walk through NovaHealth's current model & serving constraints
- Review integration points (auth, VPC peering, data flow)
- Surface performance/cost targets and quantization/latency constraints
- Confirm success criteria for the initial pilot (throughput, latency SLOs, data residency)

Proposed attendees from Redwood: myself (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer), + our infra lead (TBC). From NovaHealth, can you confirm the ML engineer and infra/network contact who should join?

Suggested time windows (PT):
- Tue 16 May, 10:00-11:30 or 13:00-14:30
- Wed 17 May, 14:00-15:30 (preferred)

If any of those work, I can send a calendar invite and include a draft agenda (attached). If not, please share 2-3 preferred times and we'll align.

I attached the product architecture diagram we referenced and a draft agenda for the deep dive. Also linking a short mutual action plan so we can lock dates and owners.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
